script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. NEW YORK CITY - DAY

The bustling metropolis of New York City, where skyscrapers tower above vibrant streets filled with people going about their day.

INT. NEW YORK UNIVERSITY - LAB - DAY

Professor JAMES HAWTHORNE (60s, intense, intelligent) stands before an impressive array of high-tech equipment. His graduate assistant, LUCY LI (20s, focused, determined) assists him in preparing a revolutionary AI for public debut.

HAWTHORNE
(whispering to himself)
Just a few more tweaks, and we'll change the world.

INT. NEW YORK UNIVERSITY - LECTURE HALL - DAY

Hawthorne delivers an impassioned speech to a captivated audience about the transformative potential of artificial intelligence in sports.

HAWTHORNE
We believe that AI can enhance our understanding of sports and help us improve performance at all levels. Today, we'll unveil a groundbreaking AI that will forever change how we view the game.

INT. CENTRAL PARK - SOCCER FIELD - DAY

A youth soccer match takes place. The coach, MIKE HARRIS (40s, passionate, energetic), encourages his team as they struggle against an opposing team.

INT. NEW YORK UNIVERSITY - LAB - NIGHT

Hawthorne and Lucy work late into the night, preparing the AI for its debut.

HAWTHORNE
This is it, Lucy. The world is about to witness the future of sports.

INT. NEW YORK UNIVERSITY - LECTURE HALL - DAY

The next day, Hawthorne and Lucy present the AI to the public. The AI, named "SportAI," is a large, spherical robot with advanced sensors and a holographic interface.

HAWTHORNE
(presenting SportAI)
Ladies and gentlemen, allow me to introduce SportAI, your new personal coach, analyst, and training partner. SportAI will help you understand the game like never before, and guide you to becoming the best athlete you can be.

INT. NEW YORK CITY - SOCCER FIELD - DAY

Mike Harris and his team are the first to test SportAI during practice. The AI seamlessly integrates into their training routine, providing valuable insights and encouragement.

INT. NEW YORK UNIVERSITY - LAB - NIGHT

Hawthorne and Lucy continue to improve SportAI, pushing it to new limits.

HAWTHORNE
We've created something incredible, Lucy. SportAI is going to change the face of sports.

INT. CENTRAL PARK - SOCCER FIELD - DAY

During a major tournament, Mike Harris and his team, with the help of SportAI, outmaneuver their opponents, demonstrating the incredible potential of AI in sports.

INT. NEW YORK UNIVERSITY - LECTURE HALL - DAY

Hawthorne stands before an audience of athletes, coaches, and journalists, reflecting on the impact of SportAI.

HAWTHORNE
We've only just begun to scratch the surface of what SportAI can do. Together, we can use this technology to elevate performance, unlock potential, and redefine the very essence of sports.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
